svg.text: Simplex: n + 1 trial guesses in n-dimensional parameter space
size: one more vertex than the fit has free parameters
but the rule is the same:
a normal run, two free parameters
near the minimum both tests pass: the normal stop
if iterations run out here: converged
if iterations run out here: incomplete
two parameters, so here the simplex is three vertices: a triangle
each vertex is one complete candidate. A step replaces the worst vertex, so the triangle flips and walks downhill
ellipses are contours of equal cost over two parameters (e.g. range, vertical speed): cost is a score, not a search axis
stop rule: all vertices are within the position tolerance on every axis AND the cost spread is below its limit.
if the iteration limit ends the fit with every axis collapsed, that also counts as converged.
